# Agent swarm dispatch

1. Resolve the active SharedVSCode worktree and read
   `.ai/policy/agent-swarm-dispatch.md` there before claiming or dispatching
   work. For RRSBS work, also read `.ai/workflows/rrsbs-swarm-dispatch.md`.
2. Record one claim in the coordination ledger before dispatch: task ID, exact
   writable files or read-only scope, prerequisites, selected profile, evidence
   path, and release condition. Re-check the ledger and `git status` before
   editing.
3. Select the least capable safe profile from the policy: `J-L`, `J-M`, `S-H`,
   `C-H`, or `HITL`. Record the profile in the claim and worker prompt.
4. Give every worker one bounded unit, explicit exclusions, exact verification,
   and the shared-worktree warning. Do not overlap writable files.
5. Keep the coordinator responsible for integration, board reconciliation,
   dependency advancement, and commits. Workers stop for ambiguity, overlap,
   secret/security/live-system/destructive work, or an unsatisfied gate.
6. Require a handoff that separates verified evidence from assertions, lists
   changed files and commands, and releases the claim.
